commands.review_summary:
The branch extends Policy doctor repair metadata and automatic narrowing repairs so denied Gateway HTTP endpoint `enabled` paths can be set to `false` while nested endpoint config is preserved.

PR surface: Source +1154, Tests +874, Docs +32, Other +8. Total +2068 across 20 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review finding: current PR-head docs describe only channel repair while PR-head metadata and repair wiring include Gateway HTTP endpoint repair. I did not run tests because this was a read-only source review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The remaining docs fix is narrow, but missing contributor proof, protected maintainer labeling, draft stack state, and security-boundary acceptance make this a human review path rather than an automated repair job.

target.title: policy: repair denied gateway http endpoints
target.body:
## Summary  - Stack on #99720 to add the next policy doctor repair slice. - Classify `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled` as an automatic narrowing repair. - Wire `doctor --fix` to set exact reported denied Gateway HTTP endpoint `enabled` paths to `false`. - Leave URL-fetch allowlist findings manual; this PR only disables denied endpoints and preserves nested endpoint config.  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` (293 tests) - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-channel-ingress-repairs` (clean)  ## Stack  - Stacked on #99720 / #99700 / #99690 / #99686 / #99121. - Review after #99720, then rebase onto `main` as the lower stack lands.  ## Not Run  - `pnpm tsgo:core` remains locally blocked by unrelated untracked `src/oc-path/` unused-symbol errors in this worktree.## Real behavior proofBehavior or issue addressed:`doctor --fix` repairs denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings by setting the reported endpoint `enabled` path to `false` while preserving nested endpoint config, with URL-fetch allowlist findings left manual.Real environment tested:Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `7aebf26a24` and this PR head `c6d9e758e9`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.Exact steps or command run after this patch:1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`4. `pnpm lint:extensions`5. `git diff --check`
6. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`Evidence after fix:The focused policy/core/CLI/tooling Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests, 7 SDK surface tooling tests, 13 policy CLI tests, and 334 policy doctor/doctor-lint tests, including `repairs denied gateway HTTP endpoint findings`. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, `git diff --check`, and `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` all exited 0.Observed result after fix:Denied Gateway HTTP endpoint repair disables only the reported endpoint path and does not rewrite nested URL-fetch options.What was not tested:No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
